payload.teaser: Today's word comes from a story about a bicycle race around Mount Royal.

reveal.excerpt: The circuit included the Voie Camillien-Houde climb (2.3 kilometres (1.4 mi) at 6.2% average gradient), the Chemin de la Polytechnique with sections exceeding 11% gradient, and a false flat rising along Avenue du Parc, which served as the finish line.
